_about: Boeing (McDonnell Douglas), DC/MD-10 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (DAC-67803A, Revision A April 2004), 2.2, Model DC-10 Series 30 and 30CF (page index 13): its front view, layers.py --mode image --unrotate --rotate 180 at scale 4, clip 137,132,492,262: at the side's scale (its span within 0.7% of the printed 50.39 m); its fuselage circle is drawn 2% small (5.90 m), so crownTop is the circle's middle less the printed radius. Pixels of that raster, line centres; the right half as drawn (the aircraft's left side). The fuselage's circle is crossed by grid lines and the cockpit's glass, so fuselage.section is free points on it, bridged (its middle (702, 361), 79 px across, 79 px up). The wing's upper line runs along a grid line inboard (y 394.5). The inlets are the nacelles' outer rings. The tail engine's inlet is the outer ring's free points, bridged (its middle (702, 232), 40 px across, 38 up): the inner ring and the strut run close by.
